scope: Banana-vs-OOD gate (COCO yolo26n, class 46) and the box-support filter, measured with the application's BananaPreDetector and ood_gate code on open-source images. No station database, capture, camera or trained cultivar weights were used.

dataset.license: Images CC BY 2.0; annotations CC BY 4.0 (Google LLC)
dataset.fetch_failure_reason: payload was not a JPEG; rejected by validation

pools.calibration: negatives from the official validation split, bananas from the train split; used to choose the support confidence and margin
pools.benchmark: negatives from the official test split, bananas from the train split (disjoint image IDs); evaluated after the policy was fixed
pools.train_negatives: official validation split, disjoint from calibration; never evaluated

definitions.before: legacy rule: a frame is accepted when a banana box reaches banana_confidence; every cultivar box of an accepted scan was trusted
definitions.after: an accepted frame yields a cultivar only when an annotated object box is covered by banana evidence
definitions.annotated_boxes: Open Images object boxes stand in for a worst-case closed-set model that boxes every object
definitions.banana_group: generic banana photographs; a proxy for the gate only, not Lakatan/Latundan/Cardaba station images
definitions.simulated_scans: four unrelated photographs treated as four camera views (seed 20261112); bounds the structural effect, not a station measurement

error_analysis.calibration_false_accepts: 11 frames inspected: all lookalikes (lemon slices, grapefruit, pineapple, yellow squash, zucchini, cucumber, pumpkin, potato wedges, a cupcake); no real banana
error_analysis.benchmark_false_accepts: 23 frames inspected after evaluation: lookalikes (yellow watermelon 0.90, mango slice 0.89, yellow squash 0.84, cheese, peppers, pickles, croissants); 1 frame labelled Pear contains a real unlabelled banana (score 0.70) and a second is doubtful, so the true false-accept rate is slightly lower than reported. The benchmark was not altered.
error_analysis.banana_misses: 27 calibration banana frames below 0.30: peeled or sliced bananas, drawings, small bananas in market scenes, and green bunches on the plant (scores 0.09-0.21)
error_analysis.train_negative_screen: 16 of 998 training negatives scored 0.15 or higher and were inspected; 1 showed a real banana bunch and is excluded (EXCLUDED_TRAIN_NEGATIVES)
error_analysis.synthetic_frames: blank, noise, blurred noise and plain yellow/green shapes give no banana evidence; a blurred banana-shaped yellow crescent scores 0.32 and passes the gate
error_analysis.rejected_alternatives: a competing-COCO-class veto and box-overlap support rules were measured on calibration and gave no better trade-off than the centre rule

not_measured: Per-cultivar precision, recall and F1 before and after the gate: the trained cultivar weights and labeled dataset are not in the repository. Run evaluate_ood_gate.py pipeline where they exist.
False-cultivar rate of the closed-set cultivar model itself on OOD images (same reason).
Station recall for Lakatan, Latundan and Cardaba hands in the Top, Left, Right and Rear views, including unripe green fruit.
Effect of retraining with the background negatives: no training was run.
